header.name: Wireless System Implementation
header.description: This course will help the students to design and implement a basic wireless communication system. Starting with the large scale propagation models, the students will study the modelling of wireless channel as a linear time varying filter, statistical multipath models and wireless Digital Modulation/ Digital Demodulation techniques. The performance of the digital modulation techniques in Rayleigh fading channel, and with different spatial diversity techniques will also be studied. Moreover, the course will also highlight the trade-off associated between single-carrier and multicarrier (e.g. OFDM) modulation techniques. . The course also involves a hardware (NI USRP) / software (using Matlab) project where the students will validate the theoretical concept studied during lectures

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to analyze the behavior of large scale and small scale wireless propagation models

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: performance (in Matlab, GNU Radio, LabVIEW) of a wireless communication system in various channel conditions

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to analyze the benefits of multicarrier systems over single carrier systems.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: implement a basic wireless communication system using software such as Matlab, GNU Radio or LabVIEW

lecture_topics: Digital Modulations BPSK, DPSK, QPSK, FSK, QAM
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Matlab / Simulink Experiments • Transmitter Random Number generators BPSK/QPSK Modulator Transmit Pulse shaping Filters • Generation of AWGN Channel with Frequency Offset and variable time delay • Receiver Receive Pulse Shaping Filter Coarse and Fine Frequency Compensation Timing Recovery BPSK /QPSK Demodulation • Packet Based Wireless systems Frame Synchronization using Header/Marker3. Simulating a fading channel in Matlab/Simulink • Generating Rayleigh multipath fading channel

lecture_topics: Error Performance of Digital Communications in Noise
Performance comparison between various modulation schemes in AWGN and Fading channel
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Matlab / Simulink Experiments • BER Calculator • Monte Carlo Simulations • Plotting and displaying BER curves
USRP2 Hardware Experimentation • Implementing BPSK/QPSK Transmitter • Plotting/ Displaying BER for AWGN, LOS and NLOS links
• Demonstration using OFDM • USRP2 Hardware Experimentation • Implementing OFDM transmitter and receiver
